tooltips.prompt: Text prompt for the video. Image parameter is optional when present.
tooltips.negativePrompt: Text string describing what you want to discourage the model from generating.
tooltips.image: Image to use as the first frame of the video. Prompt parameter is optional when present.
tooltips.personGeneration: Control whether the model can generate videos of people. 'dont_allow' prevents people/faces, 'allow_adult' allows adults but not children.
tooltips.videoLength: Length of output video in seconds (5-8 seconds).
tooltips.aspectRatio: Change the aspect ratio of generated video. Supported values are '16:9' and '9:16'. Default is '16:9'.
tooltips.promptRunway: Text prompt for the video (up to 1000 characters). Should describe in detail what should appear in the output.
tooltips.imageRunway: Image to use as the first frame of the video.
tooltips.seed: Optional seed value (0 to 4294967295). Same seed with identical parameters will produce similar results.
tooltips.videoLengthRunway: Length of output video in seconds (5 or 10 seconds).
tooltips.aspectRatioRunway: Resolution of the output video. Available options for gen4_turbo: 1280:720, 720:1280, 1104:832, 832:1104, 960:960, 1584:672
